dog.description_text:
Yes, her name really is Broccoli Cheese, and yes, she’s just as lovable as it sounds! This 1 year old baby weighs around 37 lbs and is still adjusting to life in the city, but one thing is already clear: she loves being close to her people.

Broccoli Cheese feels most at ease when her person is nearby, and a few gentle pets go a long way in helping her feel calm and confident. She settles in nicely at night and is working on getting comfortable with her crate during the day. Like many dogs taking in all the sights and sounds of a new place, she’s still learning her leash manners, and she’ll do best with an adopter who’s excited to help her build those skills.

Registered adopters interested in Broccoli Cheese can email adopt@hbrdogs.com for more info. If you're not registered yet, do it today at hbrdogs.com!
